extension.summary: Hardened, Kodi 22 RC ready anime streaming add-on for Kodi (Nexus, Omega, Piers)
extension.description: Otaku RPDev is a hardened, resilient, high-performance anime streaming add-on for Kodi 20 (Nexus), Kodi 21 (Omega), and Kodi 22 (Piers RC). Originally developed by Goldenfreddy0703 and Team Otaku (https://github.com/Goldenfreddy0703/Otaku), this sovereign distribution by RPDevs features zero-wait background pre-caching, SmartPlay web embed continuity, multi-debrid auto-failover, native stream decryption, SWIG memory management, and 100% automated test coverage. Please Note: We do not host, create, or distribute any media content.
extension.disclaimer: Otaku is and always will be free and open-source software built upon the foundational work of Goldenfreddy0703 and Team Otaku. None of its code and resources may be sold or redistributed for commercial purposes.[CR]This addon and its developers [B]DO NOT[/B] host, create, or distribute any of the content displayed in the addon; it simply scrapes ad-financed public websites. It is the user's responsibility to adhere to all local laws.[CR]This addon and its developers are not affiliated with Team Kodi or any media providers.
